rooms.name: The Witness
rooms.sub: Looking, witnessing and public vs private grief

pairs.title: The street and the room
pairs.q: Goya paints political violence at life size for a nation. Kollwitz etches grief at the size of a page, with no politics visible. Which tells you more about war?

pairs.title: Two women before the court
pairs.lb: Saved by a miracle, and a question
pairs.q: Susanna is saved by procedure: Daniel questions the judges separately. Draupadi is saved by a miracle, and by her own question. Which rescue do our institutions depend on?
